scope: Proposition 11.1 of the manuscript “Sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional O(4) model” (preprints/Sharp-mass-bounds-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-model-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87f407df77777ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 82. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let aj ↓ 0 and let Tj be positive lattice transfer contractions with normalized vacua Ωj and full gaps mj satisfying lim infj mj/aj ≥ m∗ > 0. Suppose a limiting theory has Hilbert space H, normalized vacuum Ω, and a strongly continuous semigroup e−tH with H ≥ 0 self-adjoint and HΩ = 0. Suppose a set of centered vectors u dense in Ω⊥ has centered lattice approximants uj ⊥ Ωj and nonnegative integers nj(t) such that ∥uj∥2 → ∥u∥2 , ⟨uj, T nj(t) j uj⟩ → ⟨u, e−tH u⟩, ajnj(t) → t for every t ≥ 0. Then spec(H) ⊂ {0} ∪ [m∗, ∞), ker H = CΩ.
